
private actor ClosureRestorationGate {
    private var isOpen = false
    private var waiters = [CheckedContinuation<Void, Never>]()
    func wait() async {
        if isOpen { return }
        await withCheckedContinuation { waiters.append($0) }
    }
    func open() {
        isOpen = true
        let current = waiters
        waiters.removeAll()
        for waiter in current { waiter.resume() }
    }
}

private actor ClosureRestorationAccount {
    private var hold = false
    let entered: XCTestExpectation
    let release = ClosureRestorationGate()
    init(entered: XCTestExpectation) { self.entered = entered }
    func arm() { hold = true }
    func current() async -> String {
        if hold {
            hold = false
            entered.fulfill()
            await release.wait()
        }
        return "account-a"
    }
}

private actor ClosureRestorationDelivery {
    private(set) var count = 0
    private(set) var sawNil = false
    func receive(_ evidence: BigSyncDurablePublicationEvidence?) {
        count += 1
        sawNil = evidence == nil
    }
}

extension CloudKitSynchronizerAccountFencingTests {
    @BigSyncBackgroundActor
    func testClosureObsoleteNegativeRestorationDoesNotInvalidateNewLiveCompletion() async throws {
        let entered = expectation(description: "restoration account inspection held")
        let account = ClosureRestorationAccount(entered: entered)
        let transport = AccountFencingTransport()
        let sync = makeSynchronizer(
            transport: transport,
            store: AccountFencingStore(),
            identifier: "negative-delivery-\(UUID().uuidString)",
            recordZoneID: makeZoneID(),
            accountIdentifierProvider: { await account.current() },
            accountReplacementPolicy: .localDatasetRebootstrap,
            initialReplicaBindingAdmissionHandler: { _ in }
        )
        let adapter = AccountFencingModelAdapter(zoneID: sync.recordZoneID)
        adapter.consumedBoundaryIdentifier = "boundary-a"
        adapter.feedEpoch = 7
        sync.addModelAdapter(adapter)
        sync.domainPublicationScopeIdentifierProvider = { "dataset-a" }
        let original = try await sync.synchronize()
        XCTAssertNotNil(original.receipt)
        await account.arm()
        let delivery = ClosureRestorationDelivery()
        let inspection = Task { @BigSyncBackgroundActor in
            try await sync.restoreDurablePublicationEvidence(deliveringTo: {
                await delivery.receive($0)
            })
        }
        await fulfillment(of: [entered], timeout: 5)
        // Direct synchronize() is public and can overtake the worker's earlier
        // read-only inspection; no internal attempt state is fabricated here.
        let newer = try await sync.synchronize()
        XCTAssertNotNil(newer.receipt)
        XCTAssertNotEqual(original.receipt?.runID, newer.receipt?.runID)
        await account.release.open()
        try await inspection.value
        let count = await delivery.count
        XCTAssertEqual(count, 0, "Obsolete nil evidence must not discard a newer live completion")
        XCTAssertFalse(sync.synchronizationDrainIsActive)
        await sync.cancelSynchronizationAndWait()
    }

    @BigSyncBackgroundActor
    func testClosureCurrentNegativeRestorationDeliversOnceAndRetainsCallbackBarrier() async throws {
        let transport = AccountFencingTransport()
        let sync = makeSynchronizer(transport: transport)
        sync.addModelAdapter(AccountFencingModelAdapter(zoneID: sync.recordZoneID))
        let entered = expectation(description: "negative restoration handler entered")
        let finished = expectation(description: "replacement completes after restoration")
        let release = ClosureRestorationGate()
        let delivery = ClosureRestorationDelivery()
        let restoration = Task { @BigSyncBackgroundActor in
            try await sync.restoreDurablePublicationEvidence(deliveringTo: { evidence in
                await delivery.receive(evidence)
                entered.fulfill()
                await release.wait()
            })
        }
        await fulfillment(of: [entered], timeout: 5)
        let before = transport.databaseChangeFetchCount
        let replacement = Task { @BigSyncBackgroundActor in
            defer { finished.fulfill() }
            do {
                let result = try await sync.synchronize()
                XCTAssertNotNil(result.receipt)
            } catch { XCTFail("Replacement failed: \(error)") }
        }
        for _ in 0..<100 { await Task.yield() }
        XCTAssertTrue(sync.synchronizationDrainIsActive)
        XCTAssertNil(sync.activeRunContext)
        XCTAssertEqual(transport.databaseChangeFetchCount, before)
        await release.open()
        try await restoration.value
        await fulfillment(of: [finished], timeout: 5)
        if sync.synchronizationDrainIsActive { sync.cancelSynchronization() }
        await replacement.value
        let count = await delivery.count
        let sawNil = await delivery.sawNil
        XCTAssertEqual(count, 1)
        XCTAssertTrue(sawNil)
        await sync.cancelSynchronizationAndWait()
    }
}
